resources.string: Use your music apps and send destinations through the BMW Apps connection. This download includes AAIdrive plus Open Headunit and the optional projection add-on. Android installs them as three separate apps with your approval.

The three included apps install offline. Music apps and Google Maps are separate downloads from their official sources. Ordinary BMW music and navigation work through AAIdrive without Android Auto projection.
Android may ask you to allow installs from AAIdrive Setup. Grant that permission on the next screen, then return here.

Open AAIdrive and follow its connection and permission steps with the BMW app it detects. Allow notification access to discover your players, connect the car, and check that AAIdrive appears in ConnectedDrive.

Open a player on the phone and start playback once, then select it in AAIdrive. Only tracks and controls published by that player are available; a complete playlist is shown only when the app exposes it.
3. Send a destination to BMW navigation
Preferred on a fresh setup. Open its ConnectedDrive shortcut and select published playlist tracks in Now Playing.
Listen to audiobooks with the playback and seek controls Audible makes available.
Control the active audio session. Background playback must be supported and enabled in your player. Native BMW Apps does not display YouTube videos.
Start playback on the phone before using its audio controls in the car. Background playback depends on the app.
Open Google Maps and share a destination or directions link to BMW/MINI Navigation. BMW navigation calculates its own route to that destination; the Google Maps route and traffic are not copied.
Not installed. Choose an official source below.
Get YouTube Music from Google Play
Get Google Maps from Google Play
Keep an existing ReVanced installation and use Open above. For installation or updates, follow the official ReVanced instructions. Patched media APKs are not included in Setup.
Optional: Android Auto on the BMW screen
Use this separate experimental path for Android Auto apps on the car display. The native music controls and destination sharing above do not need it.

For optional projection, install and enable Android Auto. In its settings, tap the version information ten times to enable developer settings, then use its menu to start the headunit server. You may need to start that server again each session.
Get Android Auto from Google Play
Open Open Headunit once and complete its setup. Use landscape orientation and hardware H.264 decoding. Its self-mode connects to Android Auto on this phone.

Open the projection add-on and choose “Start Android Auto”. Allow Android’s screen-capture prompt for the entire screen. Keep Open Headunit visible on the unlocked phone, then open the projection add-on in iDrive.

Screen-capture approval is required each session. Car connection speed limits the picture; audio uses the phone’s normal car connection. Stop sharing with Android’s screen-sharing control or the projection app. Physical phone/car compatibility still needs testing.
